title: State shrimp.
bodyText: The `ōpae `ula (Halocaridina rubra), also known as the red shrimp, is established and designated as the official shrimp of the State.
bodyHtml: [§5-11.7]  State shrimp.  The `ōpae `ula (Halocaridina rubra), also known as the red shrimp, is established and designated as the official shrimp of the State. [L 2025, c 71, §2]
